rationale: Shan's work at Ruyi Dynamics spans hardware-software integrated robotics and AI deployment at scale across embodied AI and autonomous vehicles, while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure for regulated sectors like biotech and fintech. Their complementary expertise—Shan's embodied AI and computer vision foundation with Sharon's focus on agentic AI systems and LLM tooling—could spark ideas around deploying intelligent agents in robotics or autonomous contexts.
intro_message: Shan, meet Sharon — she's building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai and you're shipping embodied AI at scale; worth exploring how agent systems might apply to robotics deployment.
